label: Erythrocercus_holochlorus
summary: The little yellow flycatcher (Erythrocercus holochlorus) is a species of bird in the family Erythrocercidae. It is found in Kenya, Somalia, and Tanzania. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest and subtropical or tropical moist shrubland.
